'''Anti-trauma de-programming''' was a treatment used by [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] to help patients recover from psychological trauma such as [[Torture/Legends|torture]] and interrogation. Doctor [[Tarrek]] used the technique on [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stevan Makintay]] after his rescue from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|Desperate Measures}}</ref>
